order_wins: **Data Patterns** — wins a **Rs 585.76 crore order** from Bharat Electronics Limited for procurement of Radar Electronics _(~2.2% of mcap)_.
**Ceigall India** — receives a **Rs 225.00 crore (incl. GST) Letter of Award** from HPSIDC to develop the Bulk Drug Park (Phase I) in Una, Himachal Pradesh over 18 months _(~4.1% of mcap)_.

**Puravankara** — its subsidiary Starworth Infrastructure receives a **Rs 175.00 crore Letter of Intent** from Red Connect for civil and structural works at the Ritz-Carlton project in Chennai over 32 months _(~3.4% of mcap)_.

**Pace Digitek** — its subsidiary Lineage Power wins a **Rs 92.93 crore (incl. GST) order** from Kalpa Power to supply a 100 MWh battery energy storage system (BESS) by December 2026 _(~2.5% of mcap)_.
**S&S Power Switchgear** — its subsidiary Hamilton Research wins an order worth **over Rs 50.00 crore** from Vedanta Aluminium to supply Pot Control Systems _(~14.9% of mcap)_.
**Kay Cee Energy** — wins **two same-day RVPN maintenance orders** totaling **Rs 26.42 crore** for the Jaipur Rural and Hindaun circles _(~28.5% of mcap)_.
**E To E Transportation** — receives a **Rs 26.37 crore Letter of Acceptance** from North Eastern Railway for electronic interlocking and telecom works _(~5.1% of mcap)_.
**Jhaveri Credits & Capital** — receives a **Rs 10.65 crore Letter of Intent** from GEDA for solar rooftop installations on government buildings in Gujarat over 120 days _(~5.5% of mcap)_.

**Bajel Projects** — its associate AnantGrid Projects One (held 26:74 with NIIF) receives a Letter of Intent as the successful bidder for the Lakadia Inter-State Transmission Scheme Part-A in Gujarat, involving construction of ~270 km of 765 KV lines.
**Innovision** — bags an NHAI toll collection and maintenance contract for the Etaura Bujurg and Akhtiyari Kotila plazas in Uttar Pradesh for 1 year, at a gross value of Rs 51.54 cr.
fund_raises_fresh_equity: **NCL Research & Financial Services** — approves a **Rs 49.95 crore Rights Issue** of 49.95 crore shares at Rs 1 each, in a 7-for-15 ratio with a record date of 24 August.
**Purple United Sales** — board approves a preferential issue of up to 8,09,750 equity shares (Rs 29.15 cr) and 5,31,250 convertible warrants (Rs 19.13 cr) at Rs 360 each.
**Taurian MPS** — board approves a preferential issue of up to 5,94,400 equity shares (Rs 24.91 cr) and 8,48,800 convertible warrants (Rs 35.56 cr) at Rs 419 each.
equity_allotments: **Saakshi Medtech and Panels** — allots 20,10,259 equity shares at Rs 207 each (aggregating to Rs 41.61 cr) on a preferential basis to non-promoters for consideration other than cash (share swap).
m_and_a: **Milgrey Finance & Investments** — board approves a proposal to acquire a 60% stake in real estate firm Fidus Parkland for Rs 83.00 cr through a share swap arrangement _(~93.6% of mcap)_.
**Active Infrastructures** — step-down subsidiary Raghukul Shradha Realty executes two sale deeds to acquire property in Nagpur for a total of **Rs 35.71 crore** _(~13.4% of mcap)_.
**Shradha Realty** — step-down subsidiary Raghukul Shradha Realty executes two sale deeds to acquire property in Nagpur for a total of **Rs 35.71 crore** _(~13.2% of mcap)_.
**KKV Agro Powers** — approves the slump sale of its Cumbum retail jewellery division to KTM Jewellery for **Rs 1.11 crore** in cash _(~4.4% of mcap)_.

**Tube Investments of India** — acquires a further 2.69% of listed subsidiary Shanthi Gears (20,64,713 shares) in a block deal for **Rs 77.49 crore** all cash, lifting its holding from 70.46% to 73.16%.
**EPW India** — its holding in subsidiary Renavart Recyclers is diluted from 100% to 90% following a preferential allotment by the subsidiary to outside investors.

**Asian Energy Services** — board approves strategic collaboration with Sadhav Shipping, selling a 26% stake in its subsidiary AOSL Energy Services to Sadhav for Rs 26,000 to form a joint venture in the offshore marine sector.

**REC Limited** — its subsidiary REC Power Development transfers its project-specific SPV, Luhri Power Transmission Limited, to successful bidder Terralight Solar Energy Tinwari for a consideration of Rs 4.13 cr.
**Cyient** — its 50:50 joint venture with HAL, Infotech HAL Limited, is dissolved by the NCLT Bengaluru Bench following completion of its liquidation.

**Global Education** — the NCLT Mumbai Bench sanctions the demerger of unlisted Yola Stays' real estate business into Rishiraj Infravision; Global Education, as a shareholder, will receive 24,00,000 shares in Rishiraj in a 1-for-1 ratio.
business_updates: **Results season** — **50 companies filed** results or earnings-call material today (press releases, recordings, transcripts, presentations) — tracked in the Results tab, not itemised here.
distress_risk: **Vardhman Polytex** — the NCLT Chandigarh Bench directs the company to pay Rs 10.19 cr plus 15% annual interest since 2010 to minority shareholder Maschinen Umwelttechnik in a share-exit dispute within 30 days.
**Gangotri Textiles** — the NCLT Chennai Bench admits a voluntary insolvency petition filed by the company under Section 10 of the IBC.
**Satiate Agri** — the NCLT Indore Bench admits a Section 7 insolvency petition against the company and appoints MVK IPE LLP as the Interim Resolution Professional.
**Delta Autocorp** — receives a warning letter from SEBI over a 67-day delay in disclosing a Customs show-cause notice in late 2025.

**Godavari Biorefineries** — receives a GST show-cause notice from the Assistant Commissioner, Belgavi, demanding **Rs 17.02 crore** on ENA supplied to KSBCL from FY22 to October 2024 _(~1.4% of mcap)_.

**Raghuvir Synthetics** — receives a GST show-cause notice and DRC-01 from the DGGI Ahmedabad with a tax demand of Rs 2.24 cr (including interest and penalty) for FY21–FY25 over input tax credit availment.
other_notable: **Jyoti Ltd** — a 2002 recovery suit for Rs 1.84 cr (plus interest) filed by Navinbhai Cables is dismissed by the Bombay City Civil Court.
**Natco Pharma** — receives a US FDA Form 483 with 4 procedural observations following conclusion of an inspection at its Visakhapatnam formulations facility.
**Zydus Lifesciences** — receives final approval from the US FDA for Ascorbic Acid Injection (500 mg/mL, 50 mL vial) with 180 days of Competitive Generic Therapy exclusivity.
